mevlanamuseum.name: Mevlana Museum
mevlanamuseum.slogan: Where the turquoise dome of Rumi still draws pilgrims in.
mevlanamuseum.line: Love is the water of life; receive it in thy heart and soul.
mevlanamuseum.by: Rumi, Diwan-i Shams-i Tabriz, tr. R. A. Nicholson

catalhoyuk.name: Çatalhöyük
catalhoyuk.slogan: A 9,000-year-old town where the rooftops were the streets.
catalhoyuk.line: Houses stood wall to wall with no streets between them, and people entered through holes in the roof by ladder.

alaeddinhill.name: Alaaddin Mosque
alaeddinhill.slogan: Seljuk sultans built it, and eight of them rest in its courtyard.
alaeddinhill.line: Its courtyard tomb holds the sarcophagi of eight Seljuk Sultans of Rum, and work on the mosque ran from 1155 to 1235.

inceminare.name: İnce Minareli Medrese
inceminare.slogan: A portal carved like stone banners, under a minaret lightning cut down.
inceminare.line: Lightning struck its tall minaret in 1901, and the falling stone destroyed the dome of the 1265 madrasa.

esrefoglu.name: Eşrefoğlu Mosque
esrefoglu.slogan: A forest of wooden columns holding up a 13th-century roof.
esrefoglu.line: Built 1296 to 1299, its roof rests on 42 wooden columns, each about 7.5 metres long.
